intro: Further Concerns is an Alliance courier quest dispatched by Marshal Dughan in Goldshire to investigate rumors of an amphibious threat. The marshal sends you eastward across Elwynn Forest to consult Guard Thomas at the river crossing. It shifts your attention from central garrison duties to the worsening security crisis along the eastern frontier.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you are concerned that the rumors of murlocs are true, then do this -- travel to the eastern Elwynn bridge and speak with Guard Thomas. He has been stationed at the bridge for the past week and will know the state of the area.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Yes, murlocs have settled in and around the streams of eastern Elwynn. We don't know why they are here, but they are aggressive and at least semi-intelligent.
